sqlMap.select: SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, PRICE, STATUS FROM PRODUCTS WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #productId#

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.SUPPLIER_ID, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN SUPPLIERS S ON P.SUPPLIER_ID = S.SUPPLIER_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #productId#

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, P.CATEGORY_ID, P.SUPPLIER_ID, P.PRICE, P.STATUS, C.CATEGORY_NAME, S.SUPPLIER_NAME FROM PRODUCTS P LEFT JOIN CATEGORIES C ON P.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN SUPPLIERS S ON P.SUPPLIER_ID = S.SUPPLIER_ID
P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE #name#
P.CATEGORY_ID = #categoryId#
P.PRICE >= #minPrice#
P.PRICE <= #maxPrice#
P.STATUS = #status#
ORDER BY $orderBy$

SELECT PRODUCT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME, CATEGORY_ID, SUPPLIER_ID, PRICE, STATUS FROM PRODUCTS WHERE 1 = 1
#categoryIds[]#

SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME, AVG(R.RATING) AS AVG_RATING FROM PRODUCTS P INNER JOIN PRODUCT_REVIEWS R ON P.PRODUCT_ID = R.PRODUCT_ID GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID, P.PRODUCT_NAME HAVING AVG(R.RATING) >= #minRating# ORDER BY AVG_RATING DESC
